create_DirectionalLights: create a DirectionalLights object with custom ambient, diffuse, and specular RGB colors and light direction
create_PointLights: create a PointLights object with custom ambient, diffuse, specular colors and xyz light location
create_AmbientLights: create an AmbientLights object with a custom ambient color for uniform lighting across all points
run_diffuse: run the diffuse function to calculate Lambert cosine law diffuse reflection from normals, color, and direction
run_specular: run the specular function to calculate specular highlights from points, normals, light direction, camera position, and shininess
